title: Eye Pods Cream Eye Shadow

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Matte Finish✓ Vegan✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Gluten Free✓ Hydrating✓ Clean at Sephora

What it is: Clean, cream-to-powder eye shadow trios with a velvety, buildable formula and a weightless finish.


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Rice Starch: For smooth application and unique fluffy sensation.

- Coconut Oil: Provides luxurious slip and blendability.

- Naturally Derived Pigments: Impart instant luminosity and radiance.


Ingredient Callouts: These products are gluten-free and cruelty-free.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
Gucci Westman's tip:

-Use the lightest color to highlight the inner and outer corners of the eye to brighten and lift.

-Each Eye Pods palette has one classic "core" shade that’s a seamless base or smudgy liner, one "accent" shade for an amplified pop of color, and one "highlight" shade to brighten lids and tear ducts.

-Use Westman Atelier Eye Shadow Brush I, a flat tapered brush (sold separately), to glide color onto the lids and Westman Atelier Eye Shadow Brush II (sold separately), a dome-shaped brush, for blending.

-Apply one shade as a subtle wash across the eyelids or layer additional shades to build color and intensity.

-Use the deepest shade in each palette as a soft, smoky eyeliner on top and lower lash lines.

Tip: Swirl brush or fingers over heart logo to break top layer and activate formula.

Ingredients+

-Rice Starch: For smooth application and unique fluffy sensation.

-Coconut Oil: Provides luxurious slip and blendability.

-Naturally Derived Pigments: Impart instant luminosity and radiance.


Mica, Octyldodecanol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Oryza Sativa Starch (Oryza Sativa (Rice) Starch), Zea Mays Starch (Zea Mays (Corn) Starch), Disteardimonium Hectorite, Zinc Stearate, Silica, Potassium Sorbate, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Caprylyl Glycol, Phenoxyethanol, Tin Oxide, Hexylene Glycol +/- May Contain Ci 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), Ci 77499 (Iron Oxides), Ci 77491 (Iron Oxides), Ci 77288 (Chromium Oxide Green), Ci 75470 (Carmine).


The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
